stem: Meera rubs a small piece of fried papad on a sheet of white paper for a school activity. She holds the paper up to the light. Which observation would show that the papad contains fat?

options.text: The paper shows an oily patch that looks shiny and translucent when held against the light
The paper turns blue-black in the rubbed area
The rubbed area leaves a violet colour on the paper
The paper dries completely with no mark left behind

teacher.key_rationale: Fat leaves a greasy, oily patch on paper that appears translucent when held against light; blue-black indicates starch, violet indicates protein, and no mark means no fat transferred.
